displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists OPT in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models”. The page names Susan Zhang, Stephen Roller, Naman Goyal as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
